sourceEvidence.value: Dr. Abigail Tyler, a psychologist, may be on the verge of blowing the unsolved cases wide open when, during the course of treating her patients, she finds evidence of alien abductions.

issues.materialityRationale: The curiosity hook embeds an unsupported factual presupposition that patients reported eerily similar nighttime traumas, introducing script-level narrative specifics absent from the authorized source material.

sourceEvidence.value: Since the 1960s, a disproportionate number of the population in and around Nome, Alaska, have gone missing. Despite FBI investigations, the disappearances remain a mystery.
sourceEvidence.notes: The authorized overview describes the premise in-universe but provides no authority to claim that the film reframes actual real-world missing-persons cases.

issues.materialityRationale: Asserting that the film reframes real-world historical missing-persons cases relies on external lore, adaptation framing, or real-world FBI case lore that is not authorized in the packet.
